name: Finance
description: Manual and connected accounts, transactions, and budgets.

screens.label: Budget
screens.description: One reviewed working currency; posted owned cash/card activity only. Historical manual balances reconstruct opening ledgers; bank snapshots disclose missing history. Future plans do not claim spendable cash. Month arrows step months. Target funding and envelope/flexible modes use captured review and confirmation; Check saved records appears only after stale or uncertain writes, Discard typed amounts only with drafts. Optional Card payments reserves cash per manual card from the current month, keeping earlier full-debt accounting. Funded purchases move category cash into reserves; unfunded credit spending never creates Ready. Linked manual payments consume reserves; refunds, excess and negative payment cash stay visible. Host-confirmed saves send no payment. Provider cards keep full-debt accounting. Unlinked transfers pause totals; review Transactions, then record linked transfers in Accounts. Cover overspending before target funding. Targets remain plans.

screens.label: Transactions
screens.description: One toolbar holds All or Needs a look, month arrows, payee/notes search, Filters and Export. Rows show date, payee, category, account and amount; badges appear only for review, pending, uncleared, household, possible duplicate and unbalanced splits. Confirmed rows change category from a quiet picker. Tick rows, or the header box for every editable loaded row, up to 200; a bar pinned to the bottom then offers one reviewed category change. Payees open captured facts, Split or Edit split, and owned notes; household details omit notes. Edit private note reads a fresh SQL version, then host-confirms saving or clearing up to 4,000 bytes without changing money, categories, links or reconciliation. KV/shared rows stay read only. Moss chat always asks before changing categories, even in YOLO mode. Uncertain saves keep copyable drafts. Captured category edits and audited inverse transfer corrections await host approval; stale/duplicate corrections refuse. Busy/error states preserve filters.

screens.label: Accounts
screens.description: Accounts opens on net worth with assets and debts, one total per currency, no FX. Accounts group by kind (cash, investments, credit cards, loans, other) with group totals; debts show negative. A name opens Transactions for that account. Rows show Manual or the bank with its sync time; a bank that cannot sync shows its status, as-of dates and Reconnect above the groups. Add account offers a manual account or Connect a bank. A manual row's menu adds transactions, reconciles, imports CSV and opens Manage. Manage captures an owned version for confirmed rename/close/reopen; closing needs a valid zero ledger, current statement or pristine baseline, no future entries and resolved bill plans. Closed accounts sit in a disclosure. Record transfer reviews two active owned manual cash/card ledgers with exact amount, date and resulting balances, saved atomically with guards; no money is sent. Failed or stale reads and writes keep drafts and need a fresh review.

screens.label: Getting started
screens.description: Begin with a private manual account without bank keys, enter transactions or import CSV from Accounts. Bank connection remains available after an admin configures keys. Connected accounts can build a first-budget draft from up to three months of history.

screens.label: Reports
screens.description: Reports is a primary tab with currency-separated spending, cash flow and own-account net worth. The period picker sits top left; a currency picker appears for multi-currency activity; no FX conversion. Cash flow charts monthly income and outflow with a net dot and period totals; hover, tap or arrow keys read a month; Monthly numbers opens the table. Net worth is a dated line, read the same way. Manual net worth replays opening balances and posted entries to the owner's local date; connected accounts carry snapshots forward; no market values are estimated. Sources, coverage and missing balances are disclosed. Category/payee bars (five on phones until Show all) and monthly income/outflow open exact signed contributions, including splits, with count, total and changed-record notes. Pending spending counts; refunds reduce outflow; own transfers are excluded. Private notes are omitted; Refresh updates totals; unsafe amounts are rejected. Busy detail reads show the wait; retry is explicit.

screens.label: Finance settings
screens.description: Finance preferences, merchant rules, bank keys and recent activity. Freedom presets and the Maximum per budget move stay unavailable until confirmed reads; failures offer Retry and preserve previous values. Customize sets per-action assistant preferences. Merchant rules have server-side normalized search, exact matching counts and bounded Show more. Add/edit/disable/enable use a captured rule revision, read-only monthly examples and mandatory host confirmation. Existing history is never retroactively edited. Cancel retains review; stale/uncertain saves block until an explicit successful saved-rule check. Initialization and empty lists are distinct; persistent setup needs the Finance migration worker. Bank keys remain admin-only. Recent activity has Undo and Earlier weeks. Busy rule reads honor the server wait before an explicit retry; no write or read is automatically retried.

Upcoming plans, matches, skips and stops bills, a month at a time. Without a budget currency it offers Open Budget. The head totals due, paid and to go; skipped bills count nowhere. Desktop shows a month calendar; its bill chips open a panel with the same actions; the list groups bills by week; on phones a row's Details opens that panel. Suggested bills lists repeating charges, weekly to yearly, in the budget currency that no active plan covers; Add as bill prefills the form, Dismiss hides one for good. With no plans, suggestions replace the Add a bill empty state. One-off changes/reset need host confirmation, keeping cadence and actuals. Undo review before changing matched/skipped bills. Match reviews posted rows within seven days, nearest first, never auto-selected. Record bill entry previews a past expense on an active manual account, its balance effect and blocking same-amount duplicates. Check saved bills shows only after stale/uncertain writes. No bank instruction or auto-retry.
screens.label: Upcoming bills

features.description: On Transactions, a Needs a look row shows its guessed category with Confirm and Change. Confirm keeps the guess in one click. Change opens one picker with Always for this merchant (off by default). A category change on an owned posted unsplit SQL row saves at once with no approval dialog, and a notice names the transaction and category with Undo. Stale or uncertain outcomes save nothing and need an explicit saved-record check. Selecting several rows or choosing Review N categories opens one review before saving up to 200, without making rules. Pending, compatibility and merchant-rule requests keep their queued workflow. Shared, linked and split rows keep separate controls. An empty month offers Add transaction and Import CSV.

Envelope and optional pooled flexible budgeting with signed rollover, targets and captured confirmed changes. Card payments offers reviewed per-manual-card cash reserves from this month; existing cards default to full-debt accounting. Funded spending and refunds move category cash; explicit manual transfer pairs consume payment cash. Unfunded debt never creates Ready. Negative payment cash blocks automatic target funding. Closed cards retain visible cash for release. Historical modes stay unchanged; provider-card reserves and disabling enrollment are not supported. No bank payment is sent. Stale or uncertain saves require checking saved records.

On Budget, Enter in an Assigned field saves the typed amount and moves to the next category; Shift+Enter moves up and Escape reverts. An amount typed while another save is running waits and is sent once that save shows, unless the read shows a change from elsewhere, which asks to check saved records. Clicking a category name opens its details: this month's assigned, spent and available, its target, and quick amounts (fund target, assigned or spent last month, 3-month average spent) that fill the Assigned field for review. Move money there moves cash between this category and Ready to assign or another category, and covers overspending from Ready to assign by default. Move money waits while typed amounts are unsaved.

Start without bank keys through Getting started → Add a manual account (opens the add form). Accounts imports UTF-8 CSV into manual accounts, up to 1 MiB, 200 rows and 500 KiB of mapped entries. Explicit column, date-order and money-direction mapping precedes a read-only preview in the account currency. Rows start uncategorized. Every possible duplicate needs Skip or Import anyway. Invalid dates, sub-cent/unsafe amounts and mixed currencies prevent saving. Receipt, transactions, balance and activity commit atomically; identical replay does not duplicate rows. A changed ledger requires a fresh preview. Uncertain saves require checking saved records. No provider-account import, FX conversion or automatic duplicate deletion. Approval and completed or skipped onboarding schedule ledger initialization through the normal module worker. If setup stays unavailable, an administrator can check that Finance workers are running. Startup requests are briefly coalesced per package.

After connected or manual account history exists, Getting started builds a stored draft in the chosen budget currency. Edit amounts with Enter or Save; totals change only after persistence. Starting requires an explicit host confirmation and commits categories, assignments and draft status together. Stale reviews keep typed input for review; ambiguous outcomes require checking saved records. No bank connection is required. Budget offers Monthly refill targets: carried money plus this month's assignments count toward the plan. Current-month spending/refunds do not reopen it; future carry is provisional. Existing monthly targets stay contribution-based. Save is metadata only. Removing a target always asks for host confirmation and keeps earlier months' target history. Review target funding shows eligible suggestions first and retains current-month, ready-money, overspending, version and mandatory host-confirmation checks. No automatic funding or withdrawal of excess money.

Moss sorts each new transaction into a category and marks the ones it is unsure about as Needs a look. Whether Moss confirms its own guesses for merchants you have confirmed before, and for new merchants, follows the Sort purchases settings. A guessed category still counts toward the budget while it waits for review. SQL sync privately captures pending metadata across pages and the 100-page continuation. Posted/manual/cross-account impostors cannot replace a pending source. Changed user-reviewed settlement money requires review; newer posted user choices win. Canonical saved chunks feed shared mirrors. Handoffs clear only after complete durable updates. Legacy KV needs migration for this handoff; full update atomicity remains unavailable. User-set categories needing attention say Review needed instead of Predicted.

In chat, Moss can move money between categories, set a category's assigned total, make a merchant rule, and add, rename or archive categories. Each reports what it changed, before and after, and is logged. A move or change larger than the Maximum per budget move setting in Finance settings (default $100) asks for approval first; smaller ones follow the freedom setting. SQL merchant rules use captured revisions and atomic configuration/activity. Legacy rules copy without deletion; disabled canonical rows prevent old KV rules returning. Undo restores configuration and its activity mark together. Rule-plus-category queued writes remain separate. Settings offers rule search/counts and up to 20 owned history examples in a chosen month. Add/edit/disable/enable always ask through the host, preserve cancellation and require a saved-rule check after stale or uncertain results. Rules initialization has a separate worker/retry state; history is never retroactively edited.

On Finance settings, How much Moss does alone offers three steps plus Custom. Ask about everything makes Moss suggest every change. Handle routine, ask about new lets Moss sort merchants it knows and move money up to the limit, and asks about anything new. Run it all, review weekly lets Moss do everything up to the limit. Custom shows when the switches under Customize match none of the three. A step saves at once; if saving fails the choice goes back with an error. Until policy and limit reads succeed, controls are unavailable. Retry reloads failed settings without writing; a failed refresh keeps the last confirmed values.

On Finance settings, Maximum per budget move sets the dollar limit (a whole number from 0 to 100000, default 100). Moss asks for approval before any move or assigned total above it, at every step. It saves when you press Enter or click away; a bad or failed entry goes back to the saved amount with an error. Until policy and limit reads succeed, controls are unavailable. Retry reloads failed settings without writing; a failed refresh keeps the last confirmed values. Customize lists one switch per action Moss can take (sort purchases from merchants you have seen, move money between categories, sort purchases from new merchants, make merchant rules, add, rename or archive categories). On lets Moss do it alone, off makes Moss ask first. Connect a bank and Share an account show Always asks and cannot be switched. Reviewed native merchant-rule management always asks, independently of these assistant preferences.

On Finance settings, an admin sees Bank connection with the Plaid client ID and Plaid secret, each marked Saved or Not set, and a Replace button that takes a new value. Everyone else does not see this section. Saved values are never shown.

On Finance settings, the activity list shows this week's changes by you and by Moss, newest first, each with who did it and when. Undo reverses a row (a budget amount, a move between categories, a sorted purchase, a merchant rule, or a category added or archived) and says so inline if the data changed since. Earlier weeks loads the week before. With nothing yet it says Nothing yet.

Amounts use safe integer hundredths and decimal provider rounding. Invalid calendar months are rejected. Transfer inference requires the same currency. A batch of budget assignments validates every category and amount before one SQL commit; a rejected batch changes nothing. SQL chat and queued category edits use captured revisions and one metadata-only batch with activity. Stale, split, linked, foreign or unavailable-category rows refuse without partial edits. Explicit notes stay off activity and job payloads. Same-ID provider-window updates preserve current user categories and notes; changed money requests review. Different-ID pending replacement and concurrent sync pages need separate acceptance. Category Undo restores metadata, reversal activity and the undone mark atomically. Queue acceptance is not proof of persistence; merchant-rule and category writes remain separate.

Filters on the Transactions toolbar opens a panel for account, category, pending or posted status, manual ledger status, money in or out, uncategorized rows and possible duplicates; the button shows the active count. While the panel is closed each active filter is a removable chip, beside Clear filters. Possible duplicates match account, currency, amount, date and payee; they are suggestions and are never deleted automatically. Export > Loaded rows downloads a CSV of exactly the loaded filtered transactions with separate outflow and inflow columns, currency and posting state; it is not a complete account backup. When more rows match than are loaded, the loaded and total counts appear with Show more under the list. Export > Full history prepares owned history without notes or mirrors, refuses over 5,000 rows or 2 MiB, and retains original and inverse transfer correction identifiers.

Split or Edit split in a payee's details divides an owned posted transaction into up to 20 non-transfer allocations totaling the exact signed amount. Saving awaits persistence and checks amount, currency and split revision. Provider corrections retain allocations for repair; unbalanced splits count once as uncategorized. One part removes a split. Select up to 200 loaded owned posted unsplit rows for one reviewed category change. Review selected transactions saves all or none using captured row revisions. When Moss proposes the same change in chat, it asks first. Amounts, accounts, dates, notes and reconciliation stay unchanged; no rule is created. Cancel retains choices; changed or uncertain saves require checking records before a new review. Shared, pending and legacy-storage rows are excluded. Older hosts explain the update required. Neither action moves bank money.

Manual cash, checking, savings, cards, loans and assets need no credentials and stay private. Opening date/balance and a fixed two-decimal currency establish exact ledgers; posted entries commit atomically with replay identities and Moss-local date checks. Reconcile a statement with cleared entries, zero difference and current ledger revision; receipt, marks and activity commit together. Completed periods reject backdating; outstanding entries may clear later. More than 500 entries requires an earlier cutoff. Linked manual cash/card transfers use same-currency atomic pairs. Review an owned pair in Transactions to record one inverse correction: preserve original history, derive exact endpoints/amount/currency, recheck original/account versions and posting boundaries, confirm through the host. Closed accounts and duplicate corrections refuse. Uncertain saves keep inputs for a fresh read. Old hosts/storage need updating; provider reconciliation and automatic adjustments are unavailable.

On Upcoming, Your bill plans lists each plan with its account, how often it repeats, its first date and its expected amount. An active plan's row menu, the three dots, offers Stop future bills, or Stop sooner when an end date is already set. Either opens a dialog for the last planned date, inclusive; saving needs the current bills review. Bills after that date leave the calendar; paid and reviewed bills stay. To stop before a reviewed or changed bill, undo that review or one-off change first. Stopped plans sit last with the date they stopped and no menu. Plans cannot be edited or restarted; add a new bill instead.

assistantOnboarding.guidance: Read before writing. Budget amounts are integer cents in one reviewed currency. Read finance.budget.status for totals, ready money, revision and fingerprint; pass its tokens on writes. Never guess category ids. In flexible mode, fund the pool with finance.flex.assign; member amounts are informational. Mode changes use finance.flex.preview then explicit confirmed finance.flex.configure, including destinations when leaving. Assignment and move confirmations bind to previous totals; changed reviews reject without automatic retry. Read drafts before editing or explicitly confirmed start. Targets and bill plans do not move money. Bill reviews match owned posted transactions once; skip, undo or stop projections explicitly. Quote returned actual amounts and before/after totals. Ambiguous responses require checking saved records before retrying. No bank transfers or payments occur.

preferences.label: Maximum per budget move
preferences.description: Moves above this amount ask first, at every freedom step.

assistantTools.name: finance.accounts.list
assistantTools.description: List own and explicitly shared accounts, currencies, current balances and bank sync status. Manual account balances come from the ledger.

assistantTools.name: finance.manual.context
assistantTools.description: Read manual entry setup. Manual records only; no bank money is moved.

assistantTools.name: finance.manual.account-create
assistantTools.description: Add a manual account. Manual records only; no bank money is moved.

assistantTools.name: finance.manual.entry-create
assistantTools.description: Add a manual transaction. Manual records only; no bank money is moved.

assistantTools.name: finance.reconciliation.read
assistantTools.description: Read manual account statement entries and exact balances; no financial action.

assistantTools.name: finance.reconciliation.finish
assistantTools.description: Finish an exact statement match and protect the completed period. No money is moved.

assistantTools.name: finance.import.preview
assistantTools.description: Validate rows and identify possible duplicates without saving.

assistantTools.name: finance.import.apply
assistantTools.description: Atomically import reviewed manual transactions; no bank money moves.

assistantTools.name: finance.setup.status
assistantTools.description: Report whether bank keys are set up and whether a bank is connected.

assistantTools.name: finance.connect.start
assistantTools.description: Start connecting a bank via Plaid Hosted Link; returns a link URL to open.

assistantTools.name: finance.connect.poll
assistantTools.description: Check pending bank connections and finish token exchange.

assistantTools.name: finance.sync.run-now
assistantTools.description: Sync accounts and transactions from Plaid now.

assistantTools.name: finance.transactions.query
assistantTools.description: Query a calendar month of transactions by account, category, payee or private notes, posting status, manual ledger status, direction, uncategorized state, or possible duplicate. Manual status includes only owned posted manual entries and distinguishes uncleared, cleared-unreconciled and reconciled. Possible duplicates remain in the ledger; no automatic deletion.

assistantTools.name: finance.transaction.split
assistantTools.description: Allocate one posted transaction across 1 to 20 categories. Signed parts must equal the original amount. Refuses stale amount, currency or revision; does not move money.

assistantTools.name: finance.transaction.categorize
assistantTools.description: Set the category of a transaction from a merchant that already has confirmed history. Refuses a new merchant; use finance.transaction.categorize-new for that.

assistantTools.name: finance.transaction.categorize-new
assistantTools.description: Set the category of a transaction from a merchant with no confirmed history yet. Refuses a merchant that has it; use finance.transaction.categorize for that.

assistantTools.name: finance.budget.configure
assistantTools.actionLabel: Set the budget currency. It cannot be changed afterwards.
assistantTools.description: Choose the budget's immutable working currency. Existing assignment amounts are preserved and require explicit acknowledgement. Open legacy drafts are discarded for a fresh currency-scoped build. No currency conversion occurs.

assistantTools.name: finance.budget.status
assistantTools.description: Show the envelope budget for a month: to-be-budgeted, assigned, activity, and available per category.

assistantTools.name: finance.budget.draft.build
assistantTools.description: Build a first-budget draft from posted history in the selected budget currency. Does not assign money or overwrite an existing draft or budget. Returns a persisted draft outcome or explains missing history.

assistantTools.name: finance.budget.draft.get
assistantTools.description: Read the first-budget draft: its lines by group, the plan total, monthly income and the amount still unplanned. Reads only; the draft is started from the Getting started screen.

assistantTools.name: finance.budget.draft.update
assistantTools.description: Change one line of the first-budget draft: set its plan amount, rename it, move it to another group, or drop it. Read the draft first with finance.budget.draft.get for the draft id and category keys. To add a line that is not in the draft, give a new lowercase categoryKey with categoryName, groupName (Bills, Everyday, Fun or Savings) and amountCents. Returns the line and the draft total before and after; quote those numbers instead of adding them up. It cannot start the budget. Pass expectedRevision and expectedFingerprint exactly from the latest matching budget or draft read. A stale review is rejected; refresh and review again before retrying.

categoryKey.description: The line's category key from the draft, or a new lowercase slug to add a line.

amountCents.description: The monthly plan amount in integer cents (600 dollars is 60000).

dropped.description: True takes the line out of the budget.

assistantTools.name: finance.budget.draft.start
assistantTools.description: Start the reviewed first budget. All planned categories, amounts, activity and draft status commit together. Use the current draft id and review tokens; changed data rejects the whole start. Requires explicit confirmation.

assistantTools.name: finance.budget.assign
assistantTools.description: Set a category's assigned total for a month. Pass the total it has now as previousCents (read it from finance.budget.status); a wrong value is rejected. Returns the before and after totals. Pass expectedRevision and expectedFingerprint exactly from the latest matching budget or draft read. A stale review is rejected; refresh and review again before retrying.

categoryId.description: Id of an existing category. Never guess one; list categories first.

amountCents.description: The new assigned total in integer cents (50 dollars is 5000).

previousCents.description: The category's assigned total right now, in integer cents.

assistantTools.name: finance.budget.move
assistantTools.description: Move money between two categories for a month. Use fromCategoryId ready_to_assign to take unassigned money. Returns the before and after assigned totals. Pass expectedRevision and expectedFingerprint exactly from the latest matching budget or draft read. A stale review is rejected; refresh and review again before retrying.

fromCategoryId.description: Category to take from, or ready_to_assign for unassigned money.

toCategoryId.description: Category to give to. Must be a real category id.

amountCents.description: Amount to move, positive integer cents (50 dollars is 5000).

assistantTools.name: finance.rule.set
assistantTools.description: Always put one merchant in one category from now on. Replaces an earlier rule for that merchant and returns the before and after category.

merchant.description: The merchant name as it appears on transactions.

assistantTools.name: finance.category.upsert
assistantTools.description: Add a category (leave id out) or rename or regroup one (pass its id). Returns the before and after name and group.

id.description: Id of the category to change. Omit to add one.

groupName.description: The budget group the category sits in.

assistantTools.name: finance.category.archive
assistantTools.description: Archive a category. Refused while this month still has money assigned to it; move that money first.

id.description: Id of the category to archive.

assistantTools.name: finance.account.set-shared
assistantTools.description: Share or unshare one of your bank accounts with the household.

assistantTools.name: finance.reports.spending
assistantTools.description: Monthly spending and cash flow, including pending and household-shared transactions, with transfers excluded. Returns available currencies; mixed currencies require an explicit currency before totals are returned. No FX conversion.

assistantTools.name: finance.reports.net-worth
assistantTools.description: Daily own-account net worth from recorded balance snapshots (liabilities negated). Mixed currencies require an explicit currency before a headline is returned. Earlier balances carry forward; accounts without snapshots are omitted. No FX conversion.

assistantTools.name: finance.activity.list
assistantTools.description: List the changes Finance recorded between two times, newest first: who made each one (you or Moss), what it was in plain words, and whether it can be undone. Reads only.

from.description: Start of the window, an ISO timestamp.

to.description: End of the window, an ISO timestamp.

assistantTools.name: finance.target.set
assistantTools.description: Save monthly contribution/refill, full-month weekly contribution or balance-by-date guidance from this month onward. Weekly requires per-week cents and weekday Sunday=0 through Saturday=6; every occurrence in the month counts. Does not assign money. To remove a target, use finance.target.remove. Read budget status first.

assistantTools.name: finance.target.remove
assistantTools.description: Remove a category's target from this month onward. Earlier months keep their target history and no assigned money moves. The person always confirms first. Read budget status first.

assistantTools.name: finance.bills.read
assistantTools.description: Review upcoming bills. Plans are projections; no payment or transaction is created. Writes require the current bills review.

assistantTools.name: finance.bills.suggestions
assistantTools.description: Find likely recurring bills from the owner's own posted charges in the last 400 days, budget currency only. Each suggestion carries the account, payee key, cadence, amount, last and next dates. Plans and dismissed suggestions are left out. Nothing is saved.

assistantTools.name: finance.bills.suggestions.dismiss
assistantTools.description: Hide one bill suggestion, keyed by account, payee key, cadence and amount from finance.bills.suggestions. Nothing is deleted; a price change of more than a quarter shows it again.

assistantTools.name: finance.bill.create
assistantTools.description: Save a recurring bill. Plans are projections; no payment or transaction is created. Writes require the current bills review.

assistantTools.name: finance.bill.decide
assistantTools.description: Review a bill occurrence. Plans are projections; no payment or transaction is created. Writes require the current bills review.

assistantTools.name: finance.bill.stop
assistantTools.description: Stop a bill plan. Plans are projections; no payment or transaction is created. Writes require the current bills review. An already ending plan may stop sooner; recorded occurrence decisions are preserved.

assistantTools.name: finance.bill.clear
assistantTools.description: Return a skipped or matched occurrence to projected. Does not change the ledger.

assistantTools.name: finance.bill.adjust
assistantTools.description: Change one bill occurrence. Only unreviewed projections on active owned accounts; original schedule and ledger stay intact. Requires the captured bills review and host confirmation.

assistantTools.name: finance.bill.adjust-reset
assistantTools.description: Reset a one-off bill change. Only unreviewed projections on active owned accounts; original schedule and ledger stay intact. Requires the captured bills review and host confirmation.

assistantTools.name: finance.flex.preview
assistantTools.description: Review cash-backed pool routing or explicitly allocate available money when leaving. Past months and transaction categories are preserved. Mode changes require current-month review and confirmation.

assistantTools.name: finance.flex.configure
assistantTools.description: Review cash-backed pool routing or explicitly allocate available money when leaving. Past months and transaction categories are preserved. Mode changes require current-month review and confirmation.

assistantTools.name: finance.flex.assign
assistantTools.description: Set the total funding for the flexible pool, counted once. Pass its displayed previous total and review tokens from Budget. Member amounts remain informational guidance.

amountCents.description: The new assigned total in integer cents (50 dollars is 5000).

previousCents.description: The category's assigned total right now, in integer cents.

assistantTools.name: finance.transactions.bulk-category
assistantTools.description: Categorize 1 to 200 reviewed owned posted unsplit transactions atomically. A changed or unavailable selection saves nothing. Preserves amounts, dates, clearing and reconciliation; creates no rules.

assistantTools.name: finance.reports.transactions
assistantTools.description: Read the exact signed transaction contributions behind a selected report category, payee, income or outflow period. Uses the same currency, pending and per-owner transfer policy. Returns a bounded page plus full count and total; omits notes.

assistantTools.name: finance.transactions.export
assistantTools.description: Prepare a spreadsheet-safe CSV of owned transaction history across stored months. Optional inclusive dates and account filters; reads one SQL snapshot. Omits household mirrors and private notes. Refuses files above 5,000 rows or 2 MiB instead of truncating. Does not change financial data.

assistantTools.name: finance.transactions.confirm
assistantTools.description: Atomically confirm one to 200 captured owned posted unsplit transaction categories. Rechecks revision tokens, needs-look state and live categories; all persist with metadata-only activity or none do. Preserves amounts, notes, splits, clearing and reconciliation. No category or rule change.

assistantTools.name: finance.manual.account-review
assistantTools.description: Read an owned manual account and captured row revision, with exact ledger/statement checks and future bill-plan blockers for closing. Never returns credentials or transaction notes.

assistantTools.name: finance.manual.account-update
assistantTools.description: Rename, close or reopen an owned manual ledger after reviewing its row revision. Changes metadata only and preserves opening/currency/type, balance dates, transactions and statements. Closing requires a verified zero ledger and resolved future dependencies. Does not operate a bank account.

assistantTools.name: finance.manual.transfer-context
assistantTools.description: Read owned active manual cash/card ledgers and captured account versions for recording same-currency linked transfers. No credentials, bank instructions, shared-owner endpoints or private notes.

assistantTools.name: finance.manual.transfer-review
assistantTools.description: Review an owned linked manual transfer, its correction links and both current eligible manual ledgers. Includes captured original/leg and account versions. Closed or reconciled originals remain historical; no bank operation occurs.

assistantTools.name: finance.manual.transfer-reverse
assistantTools.description: Record one audited inverse pair for an owned manual transfer, preserving its original entries and statement history. Server derives exact amount, currency and inverse endpoints from the original; captured source/account versions, valid posting date and duplicate-correction guard must hold. Replay-safe identity. No money or bank instruction is sent.

assistantTools.name: finance.manual.transfer-create
assistantTools.description: Record a past movement as an atomic linked pair in two owned manual cash/card ledgers of the same currency. Rechecks captured versions, statement/date/precision bounds and replay identity. This records history in Moss and sends no money or bank instructions. Loan, investment, provider and shared endpoints are unsupported.

assistantTools.name: finance.rules.list
assistantTools.description: List owned canonical merchant rules, enabled state, captured revisions and categories. Normalized merchant search with exact matching count and an explicit loaded limit. Reads only; reports initialization separately from an empty list.

assistantTools.name: finance.rules.preview
assistantTools.description: Preview one normalized merchant match against owned history in a selected month. Returns a matching count, up to twenty examples and current rule. Never edits existing history or applies a rule retroactively; notes and household mirrors are omitted.

assistantTools.name: finance.rules.update
assistantTools.description: After captured review, create or change an owned normalized merchant-to-category rule, or disable/re-enable it. Requires the captured revision for edits and expected absence for creation. Commits rule configuration and identifier-only activity atomically; stale edits save nothing. Does not modify existing transactions.

assistantTools.name: finance.targets.fund
